metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows an easy exercise to help loosen up a locked-up, stiff, achy shoulder.

This exercise is gentle and will focus on quickly improving pain-free range of motion, and it's great to help lessen the affects of shoulder arthritis.

Let us know how it works for you!
